evidence: This describes a feature of HERBS designed to address tissue shrinkage.

claim: The brain was transferred to 2% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) solution for cryoprotection for 1–2 days.

evidence: This describes a methodological procedure used in the experiments.
